w10_P4_001151: A rail operator is compiling the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 9 trains, each with 7 identical wagons, with each train's total expressed in kilojoules. Each wagon's contribution is its energy of motion less 13 J lost to coupling slack. Each model wagon has a mass of 46 000 g. Each wagon's speed, in m/s, equals the number of ways to choose 2 wagons from 12. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?
w10_P4_001163: A physics club is reporting the combined energy of motion, in joules, of 6 groups of 2 identical carts. Each cart has a mass of 53 000 g. Each cart's speed, in m/s, is found by taking the area under the curve y = 2x² + 5x from x = 2 to x = 3 and subtracting 21. What is the combined energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001167: A 40 000 g cart on a lab bench rolls at a speed, in m/s, equal to the greatest common divisor of 74 and 41. Its energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules. On each run the cart's brake resistor draws 9 kJ from the cart's battery, and the net figure for the run is the energy of motion minus that 9 kJ. The bench runs 9 identical runs. What is the net energy balance, in kJ, over the 9 runs?
w10_P4_001168: A conveyor supervisor wants the net force, in kilonewtons: the force for 12 identical crates accelerating at once, expressed in kilonewtons, minus 5 kN supplied by a gravity-assisted incline. Each crate has a mass of 180 kg. The acceleration, in m/s², is 2 times the smaller root of x² - 6x + 8 = 0. What is the net force, in kN?
w10_P4_001169: A marine engineer wants the net forward force, in kilonewtons, on 3 linked model boats after a 29 kN backward mooring pull is applied to the group. Each boat's forward force is what accelerates its 21 kg mass forward, and the group's total is expressed in kilonewtons. Each boat is 1.8 m long. The forward acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 3x from x = 1 to x = 2. What is the net forward force, in kN, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_001172: A wind-turbine technician needs the net energy balance, in kilojoules, of a test nacelle's battery: 14 kJ is added by a charger at the end, and before that 23 kJ is drawn by the yaw motor. The starting figure is the energy of motion of the 45 kg test blade tip, expressed in kilojoules. The tip speed, in m/s, equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 4x³ + 1·x² is itself changing at x = 1. What is the net energy balance, in kJ?
w10_P4_001179: A 16 000 g model rocket sled is accelerated forward along a rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the smaller root of x² - 13x + 40 = 0. The rail is 30 m long. The forward force on the sled is expressed in kilonewtons. A 1 kN backward drag and then a 26 kN backward arrester force act on the sled. The test runs 11 identical sleds. What is the net forward force, in kN, across all 11, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_001180: A 66 kg crate is accelerated by a floor conveyor at a rate, in m/s², equal to the greatest common divisor of 344 and 303. The crate is 0.7 m tall. The force on one crate is expressed in kilonewtons; the conveyor moves 10 identical crates at once, and an 11 kN drum pre-load is added. The plant has 5 such conveyors. What total force, in kN, is required?
w10_P4_001181: A haulage firm wants the total force, in kilonewtons, across 11 depots, each with 3 bays, each with 7 identical trucks pulling at once. Each truck pulls an 89 000 g test sled. The sled's acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 3x² + 4x from x = 3 to x = 4. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001185: A 49 000 g cart is accelerated at a rate, in m/s², equal to the larger root of x² - 9x + 20 = 0. The depot runs 11 carts per line and 9 lines at once. The combined force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 8 kN of it is supplied by a shared gravity chute, which the motors need not provide. What force, in kN, must the motors provide?
w10_P4_001186: A 174 kg tram bogie is accelerated at a rate, in m/s², that is 9 less than the number of ways to choose 4 wheels from 8. The tram's overhead line is at 750 V. The network runs 11 identical bogies per depot and has 4 depots, all starting at once. What is the total force, in kN, required across the network?
w10_P4_001193: A safety officer is reporting a final figure, in kilojoules, for a set of 6 test lanes: it is 6 times the net figure for one lane. The net figure for one lane is the combined energy of motion of 6 identical carts, expressed in kilojoules, minus 9 kJ absorbed by the lane's buffer. Each cart has a mass of 28 kg and each lane is 20 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 6x from x = 0 to x = 2. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001198: A dock foreman wants the net force, in kilonewtons, that a winch supplies: the force for 6 identical pallets accelerating at once, less 23 N supplied by a slope. Each pallet has a mass of 25 kg and is 1.2 m wide. The acceleration, in m/s², is the smaller root of x² - 10x + 24 = 0. What is the net force, in kN?
w10_P4_001199: An 8 kg test puck is launched across an air table at a speed, in m/s, equal to the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 11. The lab launches 2 identical pucks at once, and the pair's energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules. The experiment is repeated 2 times. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ, over the 2 repeats?
w10_P4_001201: A 20 kg trolley is pushed along a hospital corridor at a speed, in m/s, equal to the sum of the squares of the whole numbers from 1 to 5. Along the way, a push adds 23 J to its energy of motion, a ramp adds 29 J, a second push adds 21 J, and a final nudge adds 7 J. What is the trolley's energy of motion, in J, at the end?
w10_P4_001203: A shipyard wants the total force, in kilonewtons, on 9 identical winch lines, each pulling 2 model hulls at once. Each hull has a mass of 176 000 g. The hulls' acceleration, in m/s², equals the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 1·x² at x = 1. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001204: A 199 000 g elevator car is accelerated upward by a hoist motor, with gravity balanced by a counterweight. The acceleration, in m/s², is 7 more than the smaller root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. The shaft is 45 m tall. The hoist force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 26 kN is added as a brake-holding reserve. What is the rated hoist force, in kN?
w10_P4_001206: A speedway engineer is compiling the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, for 2 heats of 5 races, each race with 2 identical bikes, with each race's figure expressed in kilojoules. Each model bike has a mass of 22 000 g. Each bike's speed, in m/s, is 2 times the sum of 2 and 15. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?
w10_P4_001214: A cargo airline wants the total energy of motion, in joules, of every container it moves in a day: 8 hubs, each with 10 belts, each moving 8 identical containers. Each model container has a mass of 22 kg. Each container's speed on the belt, in m/s, equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 6x from x = 0 to x = 2. What is the total energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001218: A fleet manager is reporting the total force, in newtons, for 12 identical trucks, less 27 N recovered by a shared regenerative rail. Each truck's figure is the force to accelerate 6 identical 25 000 g crates at once, less 17 N supplied by a tailgate spring. The crates' acceleration, in m/s², is 2 times the sum of 7 and 20. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001226: A port authority wants the total force, in kilonewtons, on 7 identical cranes, each stated in kilonewtons. Each crane's force is what it takes to accelerate 5 identical 186 000 g containers at once, plus 14 N for cable drag. Each container is 6 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 7x from x = 3 to x = 4. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001233: A 59 000 g sled runs along a rail at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 5x² + 6x from x = 0 to x = 3. The rail is 50 m long. The lab runs 7 identical sleds at once. The combined energy of motion then loses 10 J to friction, gains 7 J from a booster, and loses 29 J to a brake. What is the final combined energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001234: A cycling federation is compiling the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 12 teams, each with 10 riders, each doing 10 identical sprints, with each sprint's energy expressed in kilojoules. Each rider-and-bike has a mass of 36 000 g and the track is 250 m long. The sprint speed, in m/s, equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 6x² is itself changing at x = 4. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?
w10_P4_001240: A physics teacher wants the final energy figure, in kilojoules, for a demonstration: 16 kJ from a heater, plus 4 kJ from a spring, plus the combined energy of motion of 3 identical carts, expressed in kilojoules. Each cart has a mass of 48 kg and the track is 5 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, is the greatest common divisor of 70 and 114. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001251: A drone racing league is compiling the total energy of motion, in joules, of 7 heats, each with 2 rounds, each with 9 identical drones, plus 30 J stored in the finish-gate sensor. Each drone has a mass of 12 000 g. Each drone's speed, in m/s, equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 6x² is itself changing at x = 2. What is the total energy of motion, in J?
